mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,run_id,input_id,content_ref,fingerprint,actor_ref,ordinal,applied_revision FROM agent_runtime_execution_supplements WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run} AND input_id=#{input}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ordinal),0)+1 FROM agent_runtime_execution_supplements WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_runtime_execution_supplements(tenant_id,run_id,input_id,content_ref,fingerprint,actor_ref,ordinal) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{runId},#{inputId},#{contentRef},#{fingerprint},#{actorRef},#{ordinal}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_runtime_execution_supplements SET applied_revision=#{appliedRevision} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND run_id=#{runId} AND input_id=#{inputId} AND applied_revision IS NULL
